items.original_title: Scientists find dice, game tiles in Kublai Khan shipwreck, revealing how troops coped at sea
items.rss_summary:
When Mongol leader Kublai Khan launched one of the largest naval invasions in human history in 1281, he was seeking a place to resettle a defeated Chinese army – and Japan was in his sights.
But conquering Japan proved a vexing challenge for Kublai Khan’s military ambitions, and a typhoon sent the massive armada to the bottom of the sea. A campaign intended to cement the overthrow of China’s Southern Song dynasty (1127–1279) would become a rallying cry in Japan for centuries.
